name: restorm-mcp
description: Connect your AI assistant (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code…) to your running Restorm instance over MCP. A zero-dependency stdio↔HTTP bridge that discovers your local Restorm and forwards tool calls.

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s='../scripts/mcp-launcher.mjs';if(!fs.existsSync(s))throw new Error('mcp-launcher.mjs source missing at '+s+' — publish restorm-mcp from the monorepo checkout');fs.copyFileSync(s,'mcp-launcher.mjs')"

author: MonsieurDev <contact@restorm.app>
